products_and_services.business_model: Delta Corp Limited operates as India's premier listed gaming and hospitality company. It generates revenue through live, electronic, and offshore casino gaming, hospitality accommodations, dining, and online skill gaming platforms.

offerings.name: Offshore Casino Gaming
offerings.description: Operates three offshore casino vessels on the River Mandovi in Goa: Deltin Royale, Deltin JAQK, and Deltin Caravela (King Casino).
offerings.evidence_excerpt: operates three offshore live gaming casinos in Goa, namely Deltin Royale, Deltin JAQK and Deltin Caravela.

offerings.name: Land-Based Casinos
offerings.description: Operates land-based casino at Deltin Suites (Goa) and Casino Deltin Denzong in Gangtok, Sikkim under license agreements.
offerings.evidence_excerpt: operates onshore casinos in Goa and Sikkim, offering electronic gaming, slot machines and live gaming tables.

offerings.name: Hospitality Properties
offerings.description: Owns and operates luxury hotels including The Deltin in Daman (176-room five-star resort) and Deltin Suites in Nerul, Goa.
offerings.evidence_excerpt: The Deltin, Daman is a 176 room five-star resort hotel and is the largest integrated resort in the region.

offerings.name: Online Skill Gaming
offerings.description: Operates digital poker and rummy portals (including Adda52) via its subsidiary Deltatech Gaming Limited.
offerings.evidence_excerpt: online skill gaming operations are housed under its subsidiary Deltatech Gaming Limited, operating Adda52 and Adda.games.

operating_segments.description: Live and electronic gaming operations on offshore vessels and onshore hotel facilities in Goa and Sikkim.
operating_segments.revenue_contribution: Substantial majority (~80% to 85% of net revenues)
operating_segments.evidence_excerpt: Gaming operations represent the principal business segment generating the predominant portion of consolidated revenue.

operating_segments.description: Online poker, rummy, and skill-based digital casual gaming operated by subsidiary Deltatech Gaming Limited.
operating_segments.evidence_excerpt: Online skill gaming segment comprises revenue from digital gaming platforms operated by Deltatech Gaming Limited.

operating_segments.description: Hotel accommodation, food and beverage sales, and resort banqueting services.
operating_segments.evidence_excerpt: Hospitality segment comprises operations of luxury hotel properties, food and beverages and related banqueting facilities.

geographical_breakdown.domestic_india: 100% of reported operating physical assets and operational gaming revenues are situated in India (Goa, Sikkim, and Daman).
geographical_breakdown.evidence_excerpt: The Group operates predominantly in India and accordingly primary geographical segment reporting is within India.

operating_geographies.facilities: Three offshore vessels on the Mandovi River (Deltin Royale, Deltin JAQK, Deltin Caravela) and onshore casino at Deltin Suites, Nerul.
operating_geographies.evidence_excerpt: flagship casino vessels anchored on the Mandovi river and onshore properties located across Goa.

operating_geographies.facilities: Casino Deltin Denzong located at Hotel WelcomeHeritage Denzong Regency.
operating_geographies.evidence_excerpt: operates Casino Deltin Denzong in Gangtok, Sikkim under agreement with the hotel owners.

operating_geographies.location: Daman, India (Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu)
operating_geographies.facilities: The Deltin luxury integrated hotel resort (176 keys, banquets, pending casino licensing).
operating_geographies.evidence_excerpt: The Deltin in Daman spans across 10 acres with 176 rooms and extensive banqueting infrastructure.

named_customers.details: Delta Corp operates a retail direct-to-consumer (B2C) entertainment, hospitality, and gaming business catering to individual domestic and international tourists, online gamers, and resort patrons. No institutional or corporate customers are disclosed in regulatory filings.
named_customers.evidence_excerpt: revenues are derived from individual patrons visiting gaming floors, hotel guests, and registered users on online platforms.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Operating vehicle for Adda52 and digital skill gaming products.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: subsidiary Deltatech Gaming Limited carries out online digital skill gaming operations.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Venue provider for Casino Deltin Denzong in Gangtok, Sikkim.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: operating agreement with WelcomeHeritage Denzong Regency in Gangtok to manage casino operations.

named_suppliers_and_partners.description: Vendors of maritime vessels, casino gaming tables, electronic slot machines, and food & beverage supplies are not individually named in corporate filings.
named_suppliers_and_partners.evidence_excerpt: procures consumables, operating supplies and gaming equipment from various approved commercial vendors.

business_dependencies.description: Offshore casino operations are dependent on commercial gaming licenses renewed periodically by the Home Department, Government of Goa.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: offshore casino operations require valid casino licenses and vessel permissions issued by the Government of Goa.

business_dependencies.description: Operations require anchoring rights, feeder boat navigation permissions, and port safety clearances on the Mandovi River issued by the Captain of Ports, Goa.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: vessel movements and passenger transfer feeder boats operate under Captain of Ports navigation safety guidelines.

business_dependencies.description: The business model is acutely sensitive to the Goods and Services Tax (GST) framework, specifically the 28% tax on full contest entry amount / face value.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: GST Council decisions imposing 28% GST on actionable claims and face value directly impact gaming margins.

business_dependencies.description: Casino visits and hospitality occupancies correlate directly with leisure travel trends, flight connectivity to Goa, and domestic discretionary spending.
business_dependencies.evidence_excerpt: patronage is linked to tourism inflow into Goa and seasonal holiday cycles in India.

announced_plans.plan_title: Dhargalim Integrated Resort Development, North Goa
announced_plans.description: Proposed development of an integrated resort project over 100 acres in Dhargalim, Pernem, North Goa, including hotel, convention center, water park, and retail zones.
announced_plans.status: In-principle approval received from Goa Investment Promotion Board (IPB).
announced_plans.evidence_excerpt: in-principle approval granted by Goa IPB for setting up an integrated resort complex at Dhargalim.

announced_plans.description: Efforts to obtain a casino gaming license under Section 13A of the Goa, Daman and Diu Public Gambling Act for The Deltin resort in Daman.
announced_plans.status: Bombay High Court dismissed writ petition in April 2024; Special Leave Petition (SLP) filed before the Supreme Court of India in September 2024.
announced_plans.evidence_excerpt: petition challenging delay in granting casino licence at Daman was dismissed; company filed SLP before Supreme Court.

announced_plans.plan_title: Corporate Demerger of Hospitality and Real Estate
announced_plans.description: Board approved composite scheme of arrangement to demerge the hospitality and real estate business into a separate listed entity to unlock shareholder value.
announced_plans.status: Subject to regulatory and NCLT approvals.
announced_plans.evidence_excerpt: approved a draft scheme of arrangement to demerge the hospitality and real estate undertaking.

material_risks.risk_title: Retrospective and Prospective GST Show Cause Notices (DGGI)
material_risks.description: The Directorate General of GST Intelligence (DGGI) issued demand notices totaling ₹16,822 crore against Delta Corp and its casino subsidiaries, and ₹6,384 crore against Deltatech Gaming Limited, alleging unpaid GST at 28% on the gross value of bets placed rather than gross gaming revenue (GGR).
material_risks.status: Sub judice before the High Court of Bombay at Goa, High Court of Sikkim, and Supreme Court.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: received show cause notices from DGGI demanding GST aggregating over ₹16,000 crore on total bet value.

material_risks.description: The Government of Goa has repeatedly evaluated shifting offshore casino vessels from the River Mandovi to an onshore designated gaming zone or the Chapora/Zuari rivers, creating operational continuity uncertainties.
material_risks.status: Periodic license extensions granted on Mandovi River pending policy finalization.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: Government of Goa periodically extends permissions to moor offshore casino vessels on River Mandovi pending alternate location.

material_risks.risk_title: Regulatory Headwinds for Online Skill Gaming
material_risks.description: Amendments to IT Rules and higher 28% GST on full contest values severely compressed margins for subsidiary Deltatech Gaming Limited, forcing the shelving of its planned IPO.
material_risks.status: Ongoing operational strain on real-money gaming platforms.
material_risks.evidence_excerpt: implementation of 28% GST on full contest value led to substantial headwinds in the online gaming ecosystem.

event_pathways.pathway_title: Judicial / Supreme Court Resolution on GST Demands
event_pathways.mechanism: A definitive judicial ruling setting aside or upholding the ₹23,000+ crore aggregate GST claims directly governs the company's going concern status, balance sheet solvency, and dividend distribution capability.
event_pathways.evidence_excerpt: demands exceed the net worth of the company multiple times, making judicial resolution paramount.

event_pathways.pathway_title: Supreme Court Ruling on Daman Casino License
event_pathways.mechanism: A favorable Supreme Court outcome compelling the UT administration to issue a casino license would transform The Deltin Daman from a sub-optimal hotel asset into a high-margin land casino hub adjacent to Gujarat.
event_pathways.evidence_excerpt: operationalization of casino operations at The Deltin Daman would provide substantial incremental gaming revenue.

event_pathways.pathway_title: Goa Government Relocation of Offshore Vessels
event_pathways.mechanism: Mandating the transfer of offshore vessels away from the Panaji Mandovi waterfront could disrupt tourist accessibility, require significant capex, or temporarily halt gaming operations.
event_pathways.evidence_excerpt: policy decision requiring relocation of vessels could impact patron footfall and require logistical reconfiguration.

event_pathways.mechanism: Surges in domestic airfares to Goa or unseasonal monsoon patterns dampen patron footfalls and VIP gaming visits during peak tourist quarters (Q3/Q4).
event_pathways.evidence_needed: Quarterly regression analysis or internal disclosures correlating Goa airport arrival statistics and airfare indices against casino drop volumes.
